bibliographic.title: TRASH WIZARD DANGER ROOM
bibliographic.author: MOUNT ENNUI
bibliographic.description:
YOU ARE A MIGHTY TRASH WIZARD, CARRYING THE ENCHANTED BLOOD OF GENERATIONS OF TRASH WIZARDS BEFORE YOU. ELDRICH POWER COURSES THROUGH YOUR FINGERTIPS, AN UNIMAGINABLE LIBRARY OF TRASH MAGIC AT YOUR DISPOSAL.

AS PART OF YOUR TRAINING, YOU MUST ENTER AND SURVIVE THE TRASH WIZARD DANGER ROOM. DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO BE THE GREATEST TRASH WIZARD TO HAVE EVER LIVED?
